about: Regions for tools/xdk_sigmatch/region_compare.py: the fog of the native renderer (spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-09-native-renderer-fog-design.md, success criteria 4 to 6) at the daylight spots of the -BootSave Hero000 plans. The regions of the lighting validation (lighting-regions.json: 'far rock', 'far slope' and the near regions) are used beside these; this file adds far ground that lies clear of the ridge line and of the lake. Plan Task 4 defined the first of them; plan Task 6 added the far rock below the ridge, more sky and the unlit draws (the water, an unlit hill).
coordinates: rect = [x0, y0, x1, y1] as fractions of the client area (0, 0 top left). Chosen on 1942 x 1136 window shots (client area 1920 x 1080 at 11, 45).

kinds.haze: far ground behind the game's haze, drawn and lit by the native pass: counts for criterion 5 (native mean luminance 0.75 to 1.25 of the emulated one, hue within 20 degrees). The emulated far hills carry the distant-tree billboards, which the native pass does not draw (spec ruling 6): a ratio compares bare hazed ground with wooded hazed ground
kinds.sky: above the ridge: the emulated final sky (after the post chain, with clouds) against the native sky (the game's clear-sky term under the fixed exposure; no clouds); reported, not counted (spec criterion 5: 'sky regions reported')
kinds.unlit: a draw the native pass does not light (the water F6D9..., an untextured hill): flat clay or the texture alone, fogged since plan Task 6 with the ground form on that placeholder colour; listed, not counted
kinds.not-drawn: something the game draws there that the native pass does not draw at all; listed, not counted (no region of this kind at present: the lake's far surface 2B09... lies behind the water regions)

chosen_on: out/native-evidence/fog/task4_<spot>_on_shot_<t>s.png of 2026-10-09 (binary of commit 2487da6, fog on): bridge 42 s emulated, 45 s native, 48 s emulated; third 44, 47, 50. Plan Task 6's additions on task6_v_bridge_on_shot_45s.png and task6b_v_third_on_shot_47s.png (binary of commit 7242edb). A run with another camera position needs the rectangles checked again (the third spot's walk ends slightly elsewhere from run to run). The trees spot has no far ground in view.
